spans.s: + क्रिया लघु- + क्रिया, f. a trifle, बह्वारम्भे लघुक्रिया, Much ado about nothing,
लघट्, and लघटि लघटि, m. Wind.
लघय, a denomin. derived from लघु,
. To alleviate, to soften, Vikr. d. 51.

लघिमन्, i. e. लघु + इमन्, m.
 1. Lightness, Bhaṭṭ. 3, 7.
 2. A supernatural faculty to make one's self as light as one lists,

लघु, i. e. लङ्घ् + उ,
 I. adj., f. घु and घ्वी, comparat. लघुतर and लघीयंस्, superl. लघुतम and लघिष्ठ,
 1. Light, Pañc. 76, 18; easy, Pañc. 202, 4; लघीयंस्, Very light, Pañc. i. d. 119.
 2. Insignificant, Pañc. 68, 6; 172, 4 (innoxious).
 3. Quick, Pañc. 55, 11.
 4.

. Little, Pañc. i. d. 301; small, Pañc. ii. d. 38; narrow, Pañc. 170, 24.
 7. Young, Pañc. 253, 13; younger, Pañc. 220, 3.
 8. Feeble,

; living in a low position, Pañc. ii. d. 71.
 10. Vain, frivolous.
 11. Short, as a vowel, Śrut. 3.
 12. A way of flying (of birds), Pañc. ii. d. 57.
 II. acc. sing. n. घु, adv. Quickly,

(Prākṛ.).
 III. f. घ्वी.
 1. A delicate woman.
 2. A light carriage.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. ἐλαχύς, ἐλαϕρός, λαγώς; Lat. lepus (for old lephus; cf. formus for old phormus, s. v. घर्म, and रुधिर, and स्कन्ध); Lat. levis; Goth. leihts; O.H.G. lîhti; A.S. lîht.

. Wantonness, Śiś. 9, 56.
 3. Meanness, insignificance.
 4. Disrespect, Pañc. i. d. 399.
लघु + त्व, n. Disregard, Pañc. i. d. 156.
लघु-विवर + त्व, n. The opening being narrow. Pañc. 170, 25.

लाघव, i. e. लघु + अ, n.
 1.
. Undervaluing, a cause of undervaluing, Pañc. ii. d. 107; disgrace, iii. d. 113; contempt,

+ हस्त लघु- + हस्त,
 I. adj. ready, or light-handed.
 II. m. a good archer.
